text:
alex_sales: Kicking off RFI thread for Zenara Health. They want a 4-week POC (Private VPC peering + optional on-prem HSM), capability matrix, and tiered pricing for embeddings and streaming. Also asked for a security questionnaire and a sample SOW.

maria_se: I can own the capability matrix + written answers. Quick Q: embeddings target is 70 QPS steady state 1; recommend Dedicated Reserved or Dedicated?

jake_infra: Reserved Dedicated (4xA10) should hit 70 QPS with batching + KV cache. On-prem HSM supported (Thales, CloudHSM, Entrust) but field installs need ~3-4 week lead time. We can share SOC2 and ISO27001 artifacts under NDA; FedRAMP is a status doc only.

maria_se: Draft capmatrix snippet (will convert to spreadsheet):

"Requirement | Redwood response | Notes
Private VPC | Supported | Customer-managed peering + route restrictions
HSM/KMS | CloudHSM, Thales, Entrust | On-prem with lead time; PKCS#11
Embeddings throughput | 70 QPS achievable | ~4xA10, batching, KV cache
Streaming | Supported | Chunked streaming, resumable sessions
SAML/SCIM | Supported | SCIM 2.0, groups->roles mapping
Audit logs | Configurable retention | 30/90/365 days (paid tiers)
Attestations | SOC2, ISO27001 (NDA) | FedRAMP: planning note
Rollouts | Canary/A-B, fallback | Per-route model pinning
"

alex_sales: Legal asked for HSM vendor attestation + KMS flow diagram and sample NDA before sharing certs. Also want sample billing transition from POC to production and an example SOW.

sophie_prod: For pricing: propose POC 4-week reserved at 40% off list, includes 6 hours/week SE support. Production tiers: volume bands for embeddings with per-embed pricing drops, streaming billed per-token with low-latency surcharge. Add-on: extended observability retention and compliance pack. I'll draft SOW milestones (week0: connectivity, week1: baseline, week2: optimization, week3: acceptance, week4: handoff). Acceptance criteria example: embedding recall >= 0.7 on provided eval set + 95th perc streaming latency < 250ms.

jake_infra: I'll attach cert refs when NDA is signed. Cert IDs: SOC2-2024-RED-030 (NDA), ISO-RED-1180 (NDA). HSM note: we do not persist plaintext customer keys; keys remain in customer KMS/HSM and we call cryptographic operations.

legal-bot: Recommend sending NDA template first and marking cert artifacts "NDA only." We'll review SLA credit language if asked.

maria_se: I'll flag optional int8 quant path in the matrix to show cost-reduction option. Also will add row: "attestations available under NDA".

alex_sales: Next steps: (1) @maria_se finalize capmatrix + narrative by EOD, (2) @jake_infra prepare attestation placeholders & KMS flow under NDA, (3) @sophie_prod finalize pricing + SOW one-pager. Target: send RFI package once NDA returned.

maria_se: Uploaded draft capmatrix: zenara_capmatrix_v1.xlsx -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1760012345/zenara_capmatrix_v1.xlsx (flagged egress rules and SLA wording).

ajke_infra: Uploaded KMS flow placeholder: zenara_kms_flow_v1.png -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1760012345/zenara_kms_flow_v1.png

alex_sales: Thanks team. I'll assemble and send once NDA in place. End of thread.
